summary.en: An if runs its controlled statement for a nonzero condition.
summary.bn: if-এর শর্ত সত্য হলে কাজ চালাও; braces, nonzero মান আর boundary trace করতে শেখো।

notes: The if statement and scalar truth rule are available in C89 and continue in C17. C99 allows declarations mixed with statements inside blocks. This lesson uses C17 and always writes braces around controlled actions.

examples.title: Show one optional reminder
examples.explanationHtml: The true comparison enters the block and prints Review. Execution then reaches the ordinary Done statement. Two lines appear because the second line is outside the conditional block. Try forty to see the optional first line disappear.

examples.title: A false condition skips only its block
examples.explanationHtml: Forty is not less than forty, so the reminder block is skipped. Done still appears. The if does not terminate main or suppress unrelated later output. The comparison uses the same passing boundary as the first example.

examples.title: A negative value is still true
examples.explanationHtml: The first condition treats negative five as nonzero and enters. The second explicitly checks its sign and also enters. These are independent decisions, so both messages print. Writing a descriptive comparison is clearer than relying on a bare balance for a financial rule.

practice.title: Optional low-mark warning
practice.statementHtml: Read mark 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print Low and newline only below 40, then always print Done and newline.
hints: The final message goes after the braces.

practice.title: A nonzero flag
practice.statementHtml: Read flag -10 to 10. After the prompt Input: , print Active and newline only when nonzero, then End and newline.

practice.title: Two independent thresholds
practice.statementHtml: Read mark 0 to 100. After the prompt Input: , print Pass when at least 40 and Honours when at least 80, each on its own line; always finish with Done.
hints: A high mark can satisfy both if statements.

practice.title: Apply a bounded discount
practice.statementHtml: Read bill 0 to 1000. After the prompt Input: , subtract 50 only when bill is at least 500. Print the final bill and newline.
hints: The update is optional; the final report is shared.

quiz.prompt: Which scalar condition skips an if block?
What groups several statements under one if?
quiz.explanation: The braced block is one compound statement.

quiz.prompt: Does an ordinary if automatically recheck its condition?
Where does execution go after a false if with no else?
options: To the statement following the controlled statement
quiz.explanation: It skips only the controlled statement.

quiz.prompt: What does a semicolon immediately after if(condition) control?
quiz.explanation: The following visible block is then independent.

quiz.prompt: Can two independent if blocks both run?
Why check scanf before comparing its destination?
options: The destination may not have received valid input
quiz.explanation: Use values only after successful assignments.

quiz.prompt: A true if precedes an unconditional line. Which lines appear?
quiz.explanation: Both the controlled A and following B execute.

quiz.prompt: A zero condition suppresses which line?
quiz.explanation: The false block is skipped and B remains.

quiz.prompt: A negative condition is tested directly. What is shown?

keyPoints.en: An if runs its controlled statement for a nonzero condition.
keyPoints.bn: if-এর শর্ত nonzero হলে তার কাজ চলে।
শর্ত ০ হলে if-এর কাজ বাদ যায়।

keyPoints.en: Braces group several actions into one block.
keyPoints.bn: braces দিয়ে কয়েকটি কাজ এক block-এ রাখা যায়।

keyPoints.en: The statement after the block belongs to both paths.
keyPoints.bn: block-এর পরের statement দুই পথ থেকেই চলে।

keyPoints.en: An if checks once rather than repeating.
keyPoints.bn: if একবার শর্ত দেখে; নিজে থেকে বারবার চলে না।

examQuestions.answerHtml: Braces. The braced block is one compound statement.

A

examQuestions.question: Read bill 0 to 1000. After Input: subtract 50 only when bill is at least 500. Print the final bill and newline.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
#include <stdio.h>

int main(void)
{
    int bill;
    printf("Input: ");
    if (scanf("%d", &bill) != 1 || bill < 0 || bill > 1000) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (bill >= 500) {
        bill -= 50;
    }
    printf("%d\n", bill);
    return 0;
}

The update is optional; the final report is shared.
